Definition
[Weak solution of the Euler--Lagrange system] 1. ch8:8.2.4-def-2\group Existence of Minimizers We define $\mathbf{u} \in \mathcal{A}$ to be a weak solution of (45) provided \[ \sum _{k=1}^m \int _U \sum _{i=1}^n L_{p_k^i}(D\mathbf{u}, \mathbf{u}, x)w^k_{x_i} + L_{z^k}(D\mathbf{u}, \mathbf{u}, x)w^k \, dx = 0 \] for all $\mathbf{w} \in W_0^{1,q}(U; \R ^m)$, $\mathbf{w} = (w^1, \ldots , w^m)$.
